# sentry_team (Resource)

A team in the organization. The team is tracked by its numeric ID, so changing `name` or `slug` renames it in place. A team created with a personal token starts with that token's user as a member.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sentry_team" "backend" {
  name = "Backend"
  # slug = "backend" # derived from the name when unset
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the team.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Slug that identifies the team in URLs. When unset, Sentry derives it from the name at creation (adding a suffix if that slug is taken), and it then stays as it is when the name changes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Team ID. Unlike the slug, it never changes; reference teams by it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by team slug or ID.
terraform import sentry_team.backend backend
```
